Weekly update raised maintenance to 2,190 and suggests 2,040; I'm on track at ~1,900, so I'll move up to ~2,000 to protect lean mass before my final DEXA.

journal:
# Dana (p17) journal — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was clear. Entered 170 cm / 28 / 67.2 kg / female / moderately active (I lift 3-4x a week). Body fat 29.5% with "Measured by: DEXA" — nice that DEXA is an option.
- After saving the profile the Body Fat tile still said "—" even though I typed 29.5% in setup. Had to add it again via "+ Weight". Expected the profile body fat to show up.
- "+ Weight" opens "Weight & composition". When I picked DEXA the last field changed from "Muscle mass" to "Lean mass" — good, that matches my scan report (lean mass 44.2 kg). BUT the dashboard tile then calls my 44.2 kg "Muscle Mass". Lean mass is not muscle mass (includes organs, water, etc.). Mildly annoying for someone who reads their DEXA report.
- First tap on "Weight" opened the weight chart instead of the add form; the add button is the "+".
- Goal defaulted to "Maintain" (target 2,160). Had to find it under the Nutrition ⚙ to switch to Lose. Chose 0.5%/wk (default) — protein went 1.6 → 1.8 g/kg (121 g). Target became 1,830 kcal, maintenance 2,160 ± 510 "Estimated".
- Protein row shows "— g / 121 g" even after I logged 29 g protein at breakfast. I expected to see today's protein so far.
- Meals have no time field — fine. Shawarma had no macros; once that's in, the day total only shows kcal (protein total disappears).
- Body composition breakdown: "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); have 0". I have ONE DEXA reading already, so "have 0" confuses me. Also: I only get DEXA at start, halfway and end (3 scans total). If it wants 3 DEXA scans at each end, the app will never give me a DEXA verdict. That's a real problem for me — DEXA is the most accurate thing I have. Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p17/screens/1790459689389.png
- Logged 4 meals (1,784 kcal), ticked Day complete.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Weigh-in form defaults to "BIA scale" even though my bathroom scale just gives weight. I left it and only typed weight — hope that doesn't count as a BIA body-fat reading.
- Weight tile: 66.2 ▼1 kg, trend 67.1. Fine, 1 kg drop is water (shawarma salt yesterday).
- Nutrition still says "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" on day 2 — I guess because it only refreshes on Sundays, but reads odd.
- Protein still "— g / 121 g". I suspect it's because my lunch had no macros, but the app doesn't say why. I got 95 g protein today from the entries that do have macros; I'd like to see that.
- Logged 4 meals 1,710 kcal, ticked complete. Avg intake shows 1,747.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- All four meals had full macros today, and suddenly the Nutrition page says "Protein averaged 101 g on 1 logged day(s) vs a 121 g target." So my theory was right: a day with even one no-macro meal is dropped from the protein average. Makes sense, but nowhere does it say so — on days 1–2 I just saw "—".
- 101 g vs 121 g — I'm under on protein. Will try to push it but I eat what the log says.
- Weight 66.4, trend 67.0.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 65.2 kg — 2 kg under day 1 already. Clearly water/glycogen, not fat; the trend (66.8) is sensibly slow. Good.
- Now the protein card explains itself: "average of 2 complete day(s) with protein logged" → 102 g / 121 g. That hint would've helped on day 1.
- Eating ~1,600-1,650/day, below the 1,830 target. I'm fine with that for now.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 64.4 kg (-2.8 kg vs day 1 on the scale!). Trend 66.6. I know this is mostly water/glycogen from cutting carbs back, the app agrees (explain page says days 1–7 absorb water shifts).
- Read "Explain the math" end to end. I like it. But checking it against my DEXA report:
  - It says "FM = 19.8 kg (29.5% of 67.2 kg)". My DEXA says fat mass = **19.2 kg**, and I typed 19.2 in the fat mass box. The app ignored my measured fat mass and recomputed it from % × scale weight. (DEXA's own total mass was ~65 kg, not my scale's 67.2, which is why the numbers differ.)
  - Katch-McArdle uses "47.4 kg lean" = 67.2 − 19.8. My DEXA lean mass is **44.2 kg** (plus maybe ~2.5 kg bone). So the app's "lean" is ~3 kg higher than what I entered. BMR slightly overestimated.
  - Section 9 uses "0.5% × 66.6 kg trend", but section 10 says "Reference weight 67.2 kg: your current trend weight is used". My current trend is 66.6, so which is it? (I guess 67.2 was the trend at the Sunday update, but the wording says "current".)
  - Top page says ± 510, explain page says SD 259 / 95% range 510 — OK once I read it, consistent.
  Screenshots: screens/1790459844479.png, screens/1790459851766.png

## Day 6 (Fri)
- Weekend dinner, 2,181 kcal (over the 1,830 target). App didn't nag, which I like. Weight 65.1, trend 66.5.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- New warning on Nutrition: "2026-10-10: macros add up to ~1241 kcal vs 1585 kcal logged (22% apart). One of the numbers may be off." Fair — I copy kcal and macros from different apps/labels and they don't always agree. Nice catch, though on day 1 my oats were 14% off (364 vs 421) and it said nothing, so I guess the threshold is ~20%. I'll keep the label kcal since that's what I trust more.
- 7/7 days complete, avg intake 1,734. Weight 64.2 (scale down 3 kg since day 1, trend 66.2).
- Body composition breakdown still "have 0" readings. It never counts my day-1 DEXA.

## Week 1 (checked Sat day 7, before the Sunday update)
- Maintenance 2,160 ± 510 kcal/day, label **Estimated** ("0% from your data").
- Target 1,830 kcal/day (lose 0.5%/wk). Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 1,830 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data."
- Warnings: macro mismatch on 10-10. Protein 110 g vs 121 g.
- Body composition: "Not enough data yet".
- What I think: nothing learned from my data yet, it's still the formula. ±510 is a huge range. I've averaged ~1,730, i.e. already under target, and the scale is down 3 kg which is obviously mostly water. I'll keep eating like I do and wait for the Sunday update. Protein: I'll try to add a bit (can't change the life log though). No plan change.

## Day 8 (Sun) — first weekly update
- After Sunday's update: maintenance 2,220 ± 510 (was 2,160), target 1,900 (was 1,830), still "Estimated", "1% from your data". Protein target now 119 g (1.8 × 66.1 kg trend).
- "kg/week (14-day): -2.07, 95%: -3.43 to -0.71". That's 3% of my body weight per week — obviously water/glycogen from the first days, but the app shows it with no comment. A beginner might panic or celebrate. The maintenance only moved +60, so the model clearly doesn't believe it's fat — good, but that's not explained on the main screen.
- Another macro mismatch warning (16%) for today. These warnings pile up on the main page — both 10-10 and 10-11 are listed.
- From day 8 I'm running my routine with a small script (weigh in at 06:50, log each meal at its time, tick complete at night), then I review every week.

## Week 2 (checked Sat day 14)
- Maintenance 2,220 ± 510, **Estimated**, 1% from my data. Target 1,900 (lose 0.5%/wk). Recommendation text still: "Suggested intake: 1,900 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)."
- Rate shown -2.07 kg/wk (frozen since last Sunday). My scale this week: 64.2–65.1, basically flat after the first-week water drop.
- Warnings: macro mismatch notes (10-11, 10-15). Protein 107 g vs 119 g — consistently ~10% under.
- Body composition: "Not enough data yet".
- My take: I'm averaging ~1,720, 180 under target, and weight flat this week. The app hasn't learned anything yet, so no reason to change. I'll keep eating as I do. No plan change.

## Day 15 (Sun) — second weekly update
- My script stopped silently after the weigh-in on day 15 (my own script's fault / some check), so I logged day 15 by hand. All 4 meals + complete.
- New recommendation: "Your estimated rate (−1.87 kg to −0.69 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −0.33 kg/week. **Eating about 920 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,920 kcal/day.**"
  - This contradicts itself. My recent average is 1,693 kcal. 1,693 + 920 = ~2,610, but the suggested intake is 1,920 (only ~230 more). Which one? Explain page section 9 says "closing the gap needs about 921 kcal/day more" and target 1,918 in the same section. For a numbers person this is confusing; for a less careful user "eat 920 more" is dangerous-sounding advice. Screenshot: screens/1790460215072.png
  - Also: the −1.28 kg/wk "14-day" rate still includes my first-week water/glycogen drop (day 2 = 66.2 kg). My weigh-ins for the last 7 days were ~64.2–65.1, i.e. roughly flat. The explain page says early water shifts are "absorbed as a level change", yet the headline rate and the "not on track" verdict are driven by exactly that drop.
- Maintenance 2,230 ± 480, still Estimated (11% from data). Target 1,920. Protein 110/117 g.
- Decision: `plan 1900` — eat at the suggested target (~1,900), not +920.

## Week 3 (checked Sat day 21)
- Maintenance 2,230 ± 480, **Estimated** (11% from data). Target 1,920. Recommendation still the same contradictory "920 kcal/day more … Suggested intake 1,920" text from last Sunday.
- Avg intake now 1,856 (I've eaten more since my plan). Scale 63.5–64.7 all week, trend ~64.3. Protein 123 g / 117 g — finally over target.
- Warning: macro mismatch 10-20 (24%).
- Body composition: still "Not enough data yet… have 0". It's been 21 days since my DEXA. Nothing.
- Decision: no change, stay at ~1,900 until the next update.

## Week 4 (Sun day 22 update, checked Sat day 28)
- Day 22 update flipped the story: maintenance 2,230 → **2,060 ± 410**, target 1,920 → **1,740**, now 33% from my data, still Estimated. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.69 to +0.15 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.32 kg/wk. Suggested intake: 1,740 kcal/day."
- Rate (14-day) −0.27 kg/wk. Avg intake 1,884. Protein 124/117 g.
- What I think: one week ago it told me to eat "920 kcal/day more", now it says I'm on track but should eat ~140 less than I do. The whiplash is because the first-week water drop finally fell out of the 14-day window — which proves the week-3 "eat 920 more" message was driven by water weight. I trust this week's numbers more (33% from data). "On track" + "eat less than you do" is a bit mixed though: if I'm on track at 1,884, why cut to 1,740? (I guess because the point estimate −0.27 is a bit slower than −0.32.)
- Body composition: still nothing.
- Decision: `plan 1750`, follow the new target.

## Week 5 (Sun day 29 update, checked Sat day 35)
- Label switched to **Measured** (55% from my data). Maintenance **2,120 ± 340**, target **1,810**. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.60 to +0.09 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.32 kg/wk. Suggested intake 1,810."
- Rate (14-day) −0.25 kg/wk, avg intake 1,692 this week. Scale 62.8–63.6, trend 64.0. Protein 118/116 g.
- Popup banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup… Back up now / Later". Tapped Back up now → data screen → "Full backup (JSON)" downloaded. Says "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — a bit scary but OK. Counter says 36 weigh-ins for 35 days — the extra one is day 1 (profile weight + my DEXA entry both count).
- Target went 1,920 → 1,740 → 1,810 over three weeks. Settling down now.
- Body composition: still "have 0". 35 days in, my DEXA reading from day 1 is still not counted.
- Decision: `plan 1800` to match the suggested intake.

## Week 6 (Sun day 36 update, checked Sat day 42)
- Maintenance **2,130 ± 280**, **Measured**, 70% from data. Target **1,820**. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.64 to −0.08 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.32 kg/wk. Suggested intake 1,820."
- Rate −0.36 kg/wk, avg intake 1,733. Scale 62.7–63.8. Protein 122/115 g.
- No warnings. Range is shrinking nicely (±510 → ±280). This is the kind of number I trust.
- Decision: no change (1,800 is basically the target).

## Day 43 (Sun) — HALFWAY DEXA + weekly update
- DEXA today: body fat 29.9% (was 29.5%), fat mass 18.0 kg (was 19.2), lean mass 43.0 kg (was 44.2). So I lost 1.2 kg fat and 1.2 kg lean — half of what I lost on the DEXA was lean tissue, and my body fat % actually went UP. That's the opposite of "lose fat, keep muscle".
- Entered it via + Weight → DEXA (63.7 kg, 29.9%, 18, 43). Dashboard tiles vs First: Weight ▼3.5 kg, Body Fat ▲0.4%, Fat Mass ▼1.2 kg, "Muscle Mass" ▼1.2 kg. The numbers are right, but:
  - The body composition card still says **"Not enough data yet"** and the breakdown still says "needs 3 readings at each end (6 total); **have 0**" — even with 2 DEXA scans 42 days apart, and on All/3M tabs. I will only ever get 3 DEXA scans, so this app will never give me a DEXA verdict. No chart of the DEXA points either. Screenshot: screens/1790460983857.png
  - The tile calls my lean mass "Muscle Mass" — a "▼1.2 kg muscle" alarm is exactly what I'm worried about, but DEXA lean includes water/glycogen too, which the app doesn't explain.
  - Meanwhile the Nutrition page (same day) says **"On track"**. Weight-wise yes; composition-wise my DEXA says no. The app never connects the two.
  - Explain-the-math now says "FM = 19 kg (29.9% of 63.6 kg), source: DEXA". My DEXA fat mass is 18.0 kg, which I typed in. It again recomputes from % × scale weight and ignores the measured kg.
- Weekly update (before my change): maintenance 2,080 ± 210, Measured 83%, target 1,780, on track, rate −0.39 kg/wk.
- My reaction: changed goal in ⚙ to 0.25%/wk and protein to 2.0 g/kg. Recommendation immediately changed to "doesn't include your target of −0.16 kg/week. Eating about 220 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,930 kcal/day." Protein target 127 g. Good that it reacted instantly.
- Decision: `plan 1930`.

## Week 7 (checked Sat day 49)
- Maintenance 2,080 ± 210, Measured (83%). Target 1,930 (lose 0.25%/wk). Rate −0.39 kg/wk (from last Sunday). Protein 129/127 g — hitting it.
- Confusing: the recommendation still says "Eating about 220 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap", but the avg-intake tile right below now shows **1,988** — I'm already above the 1,930 suggestion. The sentence is frozen from Sunday while the intake tile is live, so they disagree mid-week. Screenshot: screens (Nutrition top, day 49).
- Scale 63.1–63.9 this week, still drifting down slowly.
- Decision: no change.

## Week 8 (Sun day 50 update, checked Sat day 56)
- Maintenance 2,060 ± 190, Measured (86%). Target 1,910 (0.25%/wk). "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.39 to −0.01 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.16 kg/wk."
- Rate −0.20 kg/wk. But this week's avg intake is **2,098** — above the target and above the app's own maintenance estimate (2,060). The page still says "On track" in big letters and doesn't point that out until next Sunday. I only noticed because I read the tiles.
- Protein 130/127 g. Scale 62.2–63.4.
- Decision: `plan 1900` — pull back to target.

## Week 9 (Sun day 57 update, checked Sat day 63)
- Maintenance 2,110 ± 180, Measured (88%). Target 1,950 (0.25%/wk). "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.25 to +0.11 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.16 kg/wk."
- Rate −0.07 kg/wk, avg intake 1,964. Protein 121/126 g. Scale 62.1–63.1, trend 62.8.
- Note: range now includes gaining (+0.11) and it's still "on track" — for a slow cut the range is wide relative to the goal, so "on track" is pretty much guaranteed. Fine for me, I'm going slow deliberately.
- Body tab tiles still show my halfway DEXA and "Not enough data yet".
- Decision: no change.

## Week 10 (Sun day 64 update, checked Sat day 70)
- Maintenance **2,190 ± 170**, Measured (89%). Target **2,040**. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.36 to −0.02 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.16 kg/wk."
- Rate −0.19 kg/wk, avg intake 1,902. Protein 119/125 g. Scale 61.2–63.1 (63.1 on Friday was a salty dinner, I think).
- Backup banner again ("30+ days since your last backup") — I backed up on day 35 so fair. Did another full JSON backup.
- Maintenance keeps creeping up (2,060 → 2,110 → 2,190) while I eat more and still lose slowly. Makes sense.
- Decision: `plan 2000`.

## Week 11 (Sun day 71 update, checked Sat day 77)
- Maintenance 2,170 ± 170, Measured (89%). Target 2,020. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.42 to −0.09 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.16 kg/wk."
- Rate −0.26 kg/wk, avg intake 2,058. Macro mismatch warning for 12-18 (15%). Scale 61.7–62.9.
- Decision: no change, keep ~2,000 until the final DEXA.

## Week 12 (Sun day 78 update, final day 84)
- Maintenance 2,160 ± 170, Measured (88%). Target 2,010. "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.36 to −0.01 kg/wk) includes your target of −0.16 kg/wk." Rate −0.18 kg/wk, avg 1,863. Protein 110/125 g this week (under).
- FINAL DEXA (day 84): body fat 27.8%, fat mass 18.1 kg, lean mass 41.9 kg.
  - Start → end: fat mass 19.2 → 18.1 (−1.1 kg), lean 44.2 → 41.9 (**−2.3 kg**), BF% 29.5 → 27.8. Halfway → end: fat mass actually +0.1, lean −1.1.
  - By my DEXA, I lost about twice as much lean as fat over 12 weeks. That's not "lose fat, keep muscle". (My DEXA numbers also don't perfectly add up between scans — the halfway % implies a much lower total mass than the other two — which is exactly why I wanted the app to tell me what's signal and what's noise.)
  - App after entering it: tiles vs First say Body Fat ▼1.7%, Fat Mass ▼1.1 kg, "Muscle Mass" ▼2.3 kg. Composition card: still **"Not enough data yet"**, breakdown "have 0" readings, even on "All". Three DEXA scans, zero verdict. Screenshot: screens/1790462024854.png
  - Nutrition says "On track" the whole second half. By weight, yes. By DEXA, my cut went badly for muscle. The app never says anything about it.
- End tasks: Full backup (JSON), Weights CSV, and Daily data export (All data, with individual food entries) — all downloaded fine.
  - Weights CSV: DEXA rows have source "dexa" and the column is honestly called "muscle_or_lean_mass_kg". Day 1 has two 67.2 rows (profile + my DEXA entry); the profile one has an empty source.
  - Daily export JSON: composition stored as "muscleMass": 44.2 / 43 / 41.9 even though source is dexa (it's lean mass). Nothing about maintenance/target history in the export — I'd have liked the weekly numbers there.
  - Backup has everything (entries, food, day flags, settings incl. my 0.25%/wk and 2.0 g/kg).

## Final review
The calorie side of this app is genuinely good. Twelve weeks, every day logged, and I watched the maintenance estimate go from a formula guess (2,160 ± 510) to something that actually knows me (≈2,160 ± 170, "Measured"). "Explain the math" is the best thing in the app — I could check every number, which is how I found the problems. The macro-mismatch warnings caught my sloppy label copying, and the protein average once I figured out why it showed "—".

What confused or annoyed me: in week 3 it told me to "eat about 920 kcal/day more" while suggesting an intake only ~230 above what I ate — it contradicts itself, and it was driven by my first-week water drop. A week later it flipped to "on track, eat less". The recommendation sentence is frozen from Sunday while the intake tile under it is live, so mid-week they disagree. Its fat-mass maths uses % × scale weight and ignores the fat mass in kg I typed from my DEXA.

My biggest complaint: I bought DEXA scans precisely to know if I was keeping muscle, and the app's body-composition verdict needs 3 readings at *each end* — 6 DEXA scans — and even then its counter said "have 0" with three DEXAs entered. So I never got a verdict. My DEXA says I lost 2.3 kg lean vs 1.1 kg fat, and the app's headline the whole time was "On track". It also calls my DEXA lean mass "Muscle Mass" on the tiles.

Would I keep using it? For calories and weight: yes. For body composition, which is what I actually care about: no. Overall: **maybe**.

## 3. Confusions
- Setup: body fat 29.5% (DEXA) typed during setup did not show on the Body Fat tile; I had to enter it again via "+ Weight".
- Body tab: tapping "Weight" opens the chart; adding is the small "+".
- Weight form: defaults to "BIA scale" even for a plain weight-only scale.
- Body tiles: DEXA lean mass is shown as "Muscle Mass" (the form correctly says "Lean mass" when DEXA is picked; daily export also stores it as muscleMass).
- Goal defaults to Maintain; switching to Lose is hidden under the Nutrition ⚙.
- Nutrition: protein shows "— g" on any day with a no-macro meal, with no explanation until later ("average of N complete day(s) with protein logged").
- Nutrition (days 2–7): "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" on day 2+ because it only updates on Sundays.
- Explain the math: section 10 says reference weight 67.2 kg is "your current trend weight" while section 9 uses the 66.6 kg current trend.
- Week 3 recommendation: "eat about 920 kcal/day more than recently" and "suggested intake 1,920" disagree (my average was 1,693).
- Week 7 (day 49): the frozen Sunday sentence "eat ~220 more than recently" sits over a live avg-intake tile of 1,988, which is already above the 1,930 suggestion.

## 5. Review
Logging calories and weight here is great. The estimate went from a formula guess to a "Measured" 2,160 ± 170, and "Explain the math" let me check every number. But I track DEXA to know if I'm keeping muscle, and the app never gave a composition verdict from my three scans. It said "On track" the whole time while my DEXA showed I lost 2.3 kg lean against 1.1 kg fat. The week-3 "eat 920 more" message also shook my trust for a while. Would keep using: **maybe**. Yes for calories, no for body composition.
